title: Inventory: every model's indexes, which keys are global, and whether a tenant can reach all its rows
description:
Outcome: Produce one checked-in table, generated from schema.ts, that lists for every model: its indexes (partition and sort), whether each partition value is global today (a constant such as newsroomFeedKey "references" or "semanticRelations", an enum such as status or versionState, a slug), whether it is already tenant-safe because it starts with a corpus id that will be tenant-unique (feedStateKey, starFeedKey, mediumFeedKey, contentNeededKey, publicFeedKey are "<corpusId>#..."), and whether at least one dense index can list every row of one tenant once its value is prefixed. Counted so far: 51 core models plus 9 plugin models; Reference has 15 indexes (16 with PR #1239), Assignment 10, Message 12, SemanticRelation 9, Item 8. Models with no index at all: Automation, ReviewRequest, ReviewReadMark, ReviewRecipientRule, EditorialPolicy, EditorialCheckSettings, ReaderHandle, ReaderVote, ReaderFlag, PublicHandleClaim (global identity, excluded). The table decides the list for PPY-1ce06f and the prefix rules for the key tasks.

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): new scripts/schema-tenant-inventory.ts (reads amplify/data/schema.ts, function and plugin schema files), output docs/tenant-key-inventory.md, linked from docs/multi-tenancy.md.

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/tenant-key-inventory.feature):
Scenario: The inventory is current
    Given schema.ts changes an index
    When CI runs the inventory script
    Then the checked-in table must match or the build fails

Dependencies: blocked by nothing. Blocks PPY-ce6207, PPY-752480, PPY-f60a1e, PPY-ef2c57, PPY-1ce06f. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: -.

Testing: The script's output is compared in CI.
Rollout: Docs and a CI check only.
Risk and mitigation: Risk: the table is hand-edited and drifts. Mitigation: generated, compared in CI.

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).

comments.text: Merged to develop: AnthusAI/Papyrus#1481 (ebf4078b0, 2026-11-13). docs/tenant-key-inventory.md generated by scripts/generate-tenant-key-inventory.ts, --check in ts-check. 187 indexes: 10 tenant-prefixed, 15 corpus-prefixed, 68 record-id, 94 global. 32 models need a tenantId index (9 with no index at all: Automation, EditorialCheckSettings, EditorialPolicy, ReaderFlag, ReaderHandle, ReaderVote, ReviewReadMark, ReviewRecipientRule, ReviewRequest; 23 whose indexes cannot list a tenant, incl. Item and Reference because their sort keys are optional so the indexes are sparse). Review the density rule before fixing the PPY-1ce06f list. One schema reader shared with the isolation generator (scripts/lib/schema-reader.ts).
